summary: Orchestra BioMed Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on underwritten offering of 15,000,000 common shares at $5.00 per share, raising $75.0M gross ($70.5M net before expenses); the November 5, 2026 last sale of $5.62 implies roughly an 11% discount. Underwriters Piper Sandler, TD Cowen, BTIG and H.C. Wainwright hold a 30-day option on 2,250,000 additional shares, which if exercised lifts gross to $81.075M. Closing is expected on or about November 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal overhang.
